outcome_label: Uncertain — insufficient to certify success or failure
diagnosis_headline: Suspected plate release outside the rack
diagnosis_summary: Around 43–45s the green plate is moved and comes to rest outside the dish rack. A measured gripper opening at 44.5s supports an inferred release outside the target. Task outcome remains uncertain — holding and intent are not measurable.

physical_events.inference: The object was moved and came to rest outside the target, with a measured gripper opening during that move: consistent with it being dropped/released before reaching the target.
uncertainties: Only 2D image positions are used; no depth.

A measured gripper opening is not by itself proof of a drop; release is inferred from the opening together with the object coming to rest outside the target, and does not establish whether the opening was intended.

muse_explanation: The pipeline infers a single transport event for green plate:1 between 43.1s and 45.0s (F0 to F2) with ~86px displacement (E0), during which a measured gripper opening occurred at 44.5s (E2, F1). The plate came to rest outside the target region for 31 consecutive rest observations from 45.0s to 46.0s (E1, F2-F3), consistent with being released outside the target. The deterministic pipeline verdict remains uncertain and the event status is inferred, not observed.

visual_interpretations.text: F0 shows the red arm with gripper apparently over a green plate on the table near the dish rack. F1 shows a green plate in motion/blur near the rack edge while the gripper appears open. F2-F3 show a green plate at rest on the table outside the rack.
F1 appears to capture the plate mid-air during the transport, consistent with the inferred movement interval, but depth and contact are not verified by the pipeline.

limitations: Only 2D image positions are used; no depth (per event uncertainties).
